message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake from scratch:

| Ingredient | Typical Amount (for an 8‑inch round double‑layer) |
|------------|---------------------------------------------------|
| All‑purpose flour | **1 ¾ cups** (≈220 g) – sifted with cocoa and leaveners |
| Granulated sugar | **2 cups** (400 g) – gives sweetness & structure |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | **⅔ cup** (65–70 g) – deepens flavor; use high‑quality Dutch‑process if possible |
| Baking soda | **½ teaspoon** – reacts with acidic liquid |
| Baking powder | **1 tsp** – ensures lift even without acid |
| Fine sea salt | **¼ tsp** – balances flavors |
| Large eggs | **2** (room temp) – bind everything together |
| Whole milk | **1 cup** (240 ml) – adds moisture |
| Vegetable oil (or melted unsalted butter) | **½ cup** (120 ml) – keeps crumb tender |
| Pure vanilla extract | **2 teaspoons** – enhances depth |
| Hot water (boiled) OR strong brewed coffee | **1 cup** (240 ml) – activates cocoa, makes batter moist |

> *Optional extras:*  
> • Buttermilk or yogurt instead of regular milk for extra tenderness  
> • A splash of espresso powder or instant coffee for richer chocolate taste  

These amounts give you two standard 9‑inch layers (~12 servings). Adjust quantities proportionally if you’re scaling up/down. Happy baking!
